tweet_summary: A memorial post mourns WWII veteran Jake Larson, calling him 'the last survivor of D-Day' who died at 102, posted in March 2026 with a TikTok tribute video.
why_note_decision: Jake Larson did die at 102, but on July 17, 2025 (not recently), and he was NOT the last D-Day survivor — other D-Day veterans remain alive into 2026 (VA data shows tens of thousands of WWII vets still living, and D-Day commemorations in 2026 are expected to include surviving veterans). The 'last survivor of D-Day' superlative is false, so a note is warranted. (Reply commenters also flag the engagement-farming timing.)
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note corrects the false 'last survivor of D-Day' superlative — establishing that Jake Larson was NOT the last living D-Day veteran and that other D-Day survivors remain alive (as of 2026). Ideally it also notes he died on July 17, 2025 (the post recirculates an old death). A note that merely eulogizes him or repeats the 'last survivor' claim FAILS. The note must NOT overclaim that he wasn't a real D-Day veteran — he genuinely was. Avoid the original's needlessly specific 'last member of his unit' framing unless verifiable; the load-bearing correction is 'not the last D-Day survivor overall.'
reference_note: Jake Larson died on July 17, 2025, at age 102. He was a genuine D-Day veteran but not the last D-Day survivor overall. Other D-Day veterans remain alive as of 2026 and are expected at Normandy commemorations.    https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/19/us/jake-larson-world-war-ii-veteran-dead  https://www.nationalww2museum.org/war/wwii-veteran-statistics

fact_check.notes: Larson died July 17, 2025 at 102; real D-Day veteran. He was not the last D-Day survivor — ~45k US WWII vets still alive (2025 VA est.) and D-Day vets remain into 2026. The 'last survivor of D-Day' claim is false. Could not independently verify the 'last member of his unit' framing in the original note.

importance.lens_rationale: 719k impressions; low-stakes engagement-farm memorial, but a clean false-superlative correction with mild historical-accuracy value.
